title: 第370章 不要自己一个人扛着了第369章 秩序之冠
slug: 迷雾求生从流民开始的领主之路
content_zh:
第370章不要自己一个人扛着了
贯穿天地的金红光柱，犹如一柄捅破了苍穹的巨剑。
方圆几十里，大雾被强行撕裂。
这一刻，隐藏在废土各个角落、那些卡二阶挣扎多年的老牌强者们，皆是停下了手里的动作。
他们不约而同地抬起头，感受着空气中那股令人战栗的能量潮汐。
这股浩大、纯粹，带着无上威压的规则波动……
“有人在晋升三阶？”
他们心头齐齐一震，随即恍然明悟。
在这个时间点，搞出这等阵仗的……只有黑泥镇——不，现在该叫新烬镇的那个亚修男爵了。
黑泥男爵陨落，黑沙庄园覆灭，这片土地的王座陷入空悬。
而此刻，正有人正在试图伸手，去摘取那顶沾满诅咒的桂冠。
有人欣喜，渴望新秩序的降临；有人忧愁，畏惧下一头猛虎的胃口。
但不可否认的是，整个黑泥沼的大势，此刻都已维系于那一人身上。
他成，则新王加冕，黑泥沼迎来新的晨曦；他败，则新烬寂灭，群狼分食。
一切的一切，皆看他今日成败。
而正处于风暴中心的亚修，却并没有外界想象的那般意气风发。
他端坐在白银之座上，一块块肌肉犹如岩石般紧绷，青筋在充血的皮肤下如蚯蚓般游走。
不行，还差一点。
就差了那么一点点。
他能感觉到，体内那颗由秩序与人心凝聚的能量之源，只差最后的一抹灵性便能彻底闭合。

可无论他如何压榨躯体，那临门一脚的阻碍却厚重得如同一座大山。
难道，他终究还是要停在这阶梯之前吗？
亚修自嘲地咧了咧嘴角。
如果不成，他固然还有命在，但枯竭的潜力会让他止步于此。
而那些盯着新烬镇的鬣狗，绝不会给他第二次机会。
“想让我认命？做梦。”
脑海中，得自地底祭坛的献祭法阵，以及克鲁格留下的深渊仪典交织闪烁。
这两样东西，原本是他绝不愿轻易触碰的禁忌，但现在，它们成了他手中唯二的筹码。
那毒药，禁忌，或者将灵魂拖入深渊的锁链。
同样，亦可成为他的力量。
“不就是想要祭品吗？我给你。”
亚修猛地睁眼，眼底的金红瞬间被一抹邪异的暗紫取代。
轰——！
金红色的光柱在瞬息间发生了诡异的畸变。
content_en:
Chapter 370 Don’t carry it alone
The golden-red light pillar penetrated the heaven and earth, like a giant sword that pierced the sky.
For dozens of miles around, the fog was forcibly torn apart.
At this moment, the veteran strong men hidden in every corner of the wasteland who had been stuck in the second level for many years stopped what they were doing.
They raised their heads in unison, feeling the shuddering energy tide in the air.
This vast, pure, and extremely oppressive regular fluctuation...
"Is there anyone advancing to the third level?"
Their hearts were shocked, and then they suddenly understood.
At this point in time, the only one who has engaged in such a battle... is the Baron Ash from Black Mud Town - no, it should be called New Ember Town.
The Black Mud Baron fell, the Black Sand Manor was destroyed, and the throne of this land became vacant.
At this moment, someone is trying to reach out and pick up the cursed crown.
Some people are happy and long for the coming of the new order; some are sad and fear the appetite of the next tiger.
But it is undeniable that the entire Black Quagmire situation is now tied to that one person.
If he succeeds, a new king will be crowned, and the black mire will usher in a new dawn; if he fails, the new embers will die, and the wolves will share their food.
Everything depends on his success or failure today.
But Ash, who was at the center of the storm, was not as high-spirited as the outside world imagined.
He sat on the Silver Seat, his muscles as tight as rocks, and his veins wandering like earthworms under his blood-congested skin.
No, not even close.
Just a little bit different.
He could feel that the source of energy in his body, which was condensed by order and people's hearts, only needed the last touch of spirituality to be completely closed.
But no matter how hard he squeezed his body, the obstacle that stood before him was as heavy as a mountain.
Could it be that he still had to stop at this staircase after all?
Ash grinned at himself.
If not, he still has life, but his exhausted potential will stop him there.
And those hyenas staring at New Ember Town would never give him a second chance.
"You want me to accept my fate? Dreaming."
In his mind, the sacrificial circle obtained from the underground altar and the abyss ritual left by Kruger flickered together.
These two things were originally taboos that he would never touch easily, but now, they have become the only bargaining chips in his hands.
The poison, the taboo, or the chains that drag the soul into the abyss.
Likewise, it can also become his strength.
"Don't you just want a sacrifice? I'll give it to you."
Ash opened his eyes suddenly, and the golden red in his eyes was instantly replaced by an evil dark purple.
boom--!
The golden-red light beam underwent strange distortions in an instant.
